say:1:1033610001:1.text: I've been keeping tabs on the Flower Grove's ecosystem for Captain Lyca and checking if there are any irregularities.
say:1:1033610001:1.source_cn: 不，没有，自从您净化后，暂时还没有异常。
say:1:1033610001:1.male: I've been keeping tabs on the Flower Grove's ecosystem for Captain Lyca and checking if there are any irregularities.
say:1:1033610001:1.female: I've been keeping tabs on the Flower Grove's ecosystem for Captain Lyca and checking if there are any irregularities.

say:2:1033610002:1.text: Ever since you purified this area, nothing's been out of the ordinary.
say:2:1033610002:1.source_cn: 莱卡队长通知后，我一直在监控奇花漫谷里的生态，观察这里...
say:2:1033610002:1.male: Ever since you purified this area, nothing's been out of the ordinary.
say:2:1033610002:1.female: Ever since you purified this area, nothing's been out of the ordinary.

say:3:1033610003:1.text: But the corruption of the Lucent Tree is still present, therefore I must stay on guard here just in case.
say:3:1033610003:1.source_cn: 毕竟流荧树的腐化仍在，我得时刻守卫在这里，以防万一。
say:3:1033610003:1.male: But the corruption of the Lucent Tree is still present, therefore I must stay on guard here just in case.
say:3:1033610003:1.female: But the corruption of the Lucent Tree is still present, therefore I must stay on guard here just in case.
